board: ClosedCube Si7051 ±0.1°C Digital Temperature Sensor breakout (B001; 4-pin VDD, SCL, SDA, GND)
reason: Check passed on ESP32 and Pico. No-hold command 0xF3 (and hold 0xE3) returns the 14-bit code with the datasheet's fixed 00 low bits plus CRC-8 (poly 0x31, init 0x00); the driver retries reads while the chip NACKs, checks the CRC and applies T = 175.72*code/65536 - 46.85. VDD limited to 1.9-3.6 V since the board has no regulator.
